_about: Per-map tables that exist only in RF4S.exe, extracted by gen_exe_tables_json.py. map_resources: g_mapResourceTable (4 archive ids per map id) as file basenames: [rf4m, ground tile 0 (layer 0), overlay tile 0 (layer 1) or null, over-model or null]; Map_SpawnEntity RF4S.exe+0x194140 loads the 1st MTXN chunk's layer from the ground id and every later chunk's from the overlay id (none when it is 0). map_type_attrib: g_mapTypeAttribTable, one u32 per map id; bit 0x10 makes Map_PostLoad RF4S.exe+0x193FB0 default the night tint to 181,214,214 instead of 148,214,247. runtime_spawns: warp zones and blocker walls Map_SpawnProgressWarpsAndWalls RF4S.exe+0x144A50 adds at load, keyed by the (base) map id; boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in sub-units (8 per tile), a warp's arrival [x, y] in the destination map; a wall is a pg_wall sprite (archive id for spring; on the farm +20 summer / +10 autumn / +30 winter, by the map's MGRP season) that sets the tiles of its box to blocked (0x2); 'when' says what gates it.
